description: A button with a trigger, a gate and a toggle output, and a stepped constant voltage source

params.text: Pressing it fires the trigger output, holds the gate output high, flips the toggle output and moves the constant voltage on one step

inputs.text: A voltage rising past 2V here does what pressing the button does

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger each time the button is pressed
10V for as long as the button is held down, 0V the rest of the time
Flips between 0V and 10V on each button press
A steady voltage that steps through 1V, 5V and 10V, moving on one step each time the button is pressed

notes: this is the one module in the plugin with no polyphony; every output carries a single channel
